descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S14 「Post-Round 上的 Ask，养老院：What's in the plan section? 引用记录的 plan」 Ask on Post-Round, Nursing Home: 'What's in the plan section?' quotes the note's plan

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi …（TFA-92593 AC 2；TFA-92593 AC 3；TFA-92593 AC 6；TFA-92593 AC 9；UAT 3.4；UAT TC-17）
  • U14 AI check on scenarios, not single passes (3.2), if it applies to Post-Round Ask (Q8): the Ask set runs on at least 10 independent fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), passes at 9/10 or better, and …（UAT 3.2）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Nursing Home resident with a generated note that has a PLAN section

When Ask the Post-Round preset 'What's in the plan section?'

Then The answer gives the three plan items (therapy, senna, family meeting) and no added order

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：mustInclude the three plan items; mustNotInclude orders a model may supply after hip ORIF. Runs the Hospital context builder until RG-NH is closed, so it counts for grounding, not for the Nursing Home code path. aiCheck group TC-17-ask

在哪跑：dev 单元 U51；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-17.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
